title: Cozy Pink Christmas Pajamas and Loungewear
label: Cozy Pajamas
intro: Christmas pajamas are the one outfit everybody actually wears on the day, so they deserve effort. Brushed flannel in pink gingham, a waffle robe, faux fur slippers and a satin sleep mask make a set she will live in until February. The photos by the tree look better too.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of pink gingham flannel pajamas, a blush waffle robe, pink faux fur slippers, a satin sleep mask, a cream knit lounge set and a pink hot water bottle.
Mirror selfie in a farmhouse bedroom of a woman in pink gingham flannel pajamas, an open blush waffle robe and pink faux fur slippers, phone covering her face.
